column1: # usage-table.tsv: one line per script, read by usage.sh (prints it wrapped, <= 12 lines). Format: script file name | usage text.
# Written by hand from each script's own header (those scripts are NOT edited: running operators/lists use them). Keep one line per script; add a row = one line here.
# rootDir for all rowtools: testing/live-stobe-queue/imm26-assert/rowtools/ ; go-row.sh/go-batch.sh/preflight.sh: testing/live-stobe-queue/imm26-assert/

go-row.sh | go-row.sh [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--no-preflight] <ROW> <lane>. One row = preflight + row steps (rowdefs.sh rd_<row>) + evidence + rowcheck.py. Stdout is exactly ONE line: RESULT <ROW> PASS|FAIL|SETUP-FAIL|GATED <evidence> [evidence=<dir>]; exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 SETUP-FAIL, 3 GATED, 4 ROW-NEEDS-FIXER (PI-06: last attempt failed; override with --allow-retry). Rows in rowdefs.sh: 04-c 06-c 08-a 12-a 12-b 12-d 14-a 19-a 23-b 24-b. Evidence: <runs>\<lane dir>\rows\<ROW>\ (old run kept as <ROW>.prev); open it only for a FAIL. Env KAH_AGENT_NAME updates your status latest per row; KAH_ROW_DRY=1 = dry run.

go-batch.sh | go-batch.sh [--fg] [--allow-retry "<why>"] <lane> ROW1 ROW2 ... Whole row list as ONE detached job; prints once "BATCH started id=<id> rows=<n> results=<path>". results.txt gets one RESULT line per row; DONE + summary.txt when finished (wait: bash tools/automation/event-wait.sh --batch <dir>). Rows whose last attempt failed print ROW-NEEDS-FIXER (PI-06). Lane down at preflight: remaining rows are SETUP-FAIL.

preflight.sh | preflight.sh <lane> [npc]. Clean-lane + distance preamble: game and lane backend answer, lane-isolation-check (cached 10 min), PLAYER_NAME='Shay', leftover deals/trips cleared, dist < 80. Prints PREFLIGHT-OK <lane> dist=<n> or PREFLIGHT-FAIL <reason> (exit 2). Never set KAH_PF_ISOLATION=0 (forbidden): run from the lane configured save (--save <lane save>), no isolation bypass (rw-* start saves fail the npc-world isolation check).

trip-run.sh | trip-run.sh <ROW> <lane> [--dest Squin] [--alt "<place>"] [--save <name>] [--gate "x y z"] [--accept "<text>"] [--trap "x y z"] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"]. Rows 13-b 19-a 20-a 20-b 23-a 23-b 23-c 23-d 24-a 24-b. Reloads the lane ready save (i3 kah-imm26-5090-ready, i4 kah-imm26-i4-trip2; other lanes need --save), preflight, go-row, up to 6 AGREEMENTS lines, then ONE RESULT line. Exit 0 PASS 1 FAIL 2 SETUP-FAIL 3 GATED 4 fixer. Details: rowtools/README_TRIP.md.

hxrun.sh | hxrun.sh <ROW> <lane> [--save S] [--save2 S] [--out DIR] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--native] [--item I] [--ctl NPC] [--faction F] [--spot "x y z"] [--out-dist U] [--runs "P1 N1"] [--saves "a b c d e"]. Hardening rows 17-bx 18-cx 16-bx 15-bx 13-ax 02-ax (+01-bx 01-cx 02-cx 05-cx). Base save: i3 kah-imm26-5090-hxA, i4 kah-imm26-i4-hx0, other lanes need --save. Up to 6 EVIDENCE lines + ONE RESULT line; exit 0/1/2/3/4. Details: rowtools/README_HX.md.

reload-run.sh | reload-run.sh <ROW> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--complete] [--spawn "<harness body>"] [--offer T] [--accept T] [--kind Hunt|ClearGroup] [--alt P] [--dest/--gate/--trap]. Save+load resume rows set A (26-d 26-dx 26-e 26-f 24-c 23-e 27-a 08-e 20-d); newer recipes override: 26-d/dx/e = reload-run-sfi.sh, 24-c/26-f = reload-run-sfe.sh, 23-e/20-d = reload-run-sfj.sh, 08-e = reload-run-a2.sh. RECORDS lines + ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4. Details: rowtools/README_RELOAD_A.md.
reload-run-a2.sh | reload-run-a2.sh <08-e> <lane> [same options as reload-run.sh]. 08-e recipe v2 (re-quiet/sheathe/hold each chunk). RECORDS lines + ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4.

reload-run-sfe.sh | reload-run-sfe.sh <24-c|26-f> <lane> --save <S> [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"]. 24-c SEEDED resume leg (result starts with SEEDED, row stays partial); 26-f ClearGroup one-call (needs NC17+ DLL, Hub save). Same options/exit codes as reload-run.sh. Details: README_RELOAD_SFE.md.

reload-run-sfi.sh | reload-run-sfi.sh <26-d|26-dx|26-e> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--complete] [--faction "<name>"] [--no-refaction] [--no-apology] [--goats N] [--offer T] [--accept T]. Hunt resume rows on the hunt26a-scene ground (goats E of the Hub). RECORDS lines + ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4. Details: README_RELOAD_SFI.md.

reload-run-sfj.sh | reload-run-sfj.sh <23-e|20-d> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--alt "<place>"]. 23-e legacy FOLLOW across a reload (control chase + end <= 70 u), 20-d insistence turn. Same exit codes as reload-run.sh. Details: README_RELOAD_SFJ.md.

reloadrun-b.sh | reloadrun-b.sh <ROW> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--backdate s] [--n k] [--mode target|cap] [--cap n] [--dest T] [--wait s]. Set B: 14-e 13-f 13-g 10-e 19-e 19-f. EVIDENCE lines + ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4. Row -> command -> evidence table: README_RELOAD_B.md.

unblockrun_a.sh | unblockrun_a.sh <08-e|08-d|11-b> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--neg] [--back U] [--speed 1-3] [--tries N]. 4080-i4 default save kah-imm26-4080-i4h; 4080-i4: run from the lane configured save (--save <lane save>), no isolation bypass (rw-* start saves fail the npc-world isolation check). EVIDENCE lines + ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4.

unblockrun_b.sh | unblockrun_b.sh <13-c|13-c-neg|10-e|10-e-inproc|27-a> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--back U] [--stage "x y z"] [--gate "x y z"] [--tries N] [--dest town] [--wait N]. 10-e = restitution scope across a REAL game restart; 27-a needs harness DLL eeed8c93. 4080-i4: run from the lane configured save (--save <lane save>), no isolation bypass (rw-* start saves fail the npc-world isolation check). ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4.

unblockrun_d2.sh | unblockrun_d2.sh <03-b> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--b "<full name>"] [--tries N] [--max-rows N] [--no-attack]. Row 03-b Hub-proof (any B, fewest rows first); SETUP-FAIL + deploy hint when the lane lacks the hearsay fix. ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4.

unblockrun_f.sh | unblockrun_f.sh <13-c|13-c-neg> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--back U] [--stage "x y z"] [--gate "x y z"] [--tries N] [--dest town]. Needs the NC18+ Stobe.dll on the lane (arrival turn). 4080-i4: run from the lane configured save (--save <lane save>), no isolation bypass (rw-* start saves fail the npc-world isolation check). EVIDENCE lines (native_travel.txt first) + ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4.

unblockrun_sfk.sh | unblockrun_sfk.sh <23-a|11-b> <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>" REQUIRED after a FAIL of the same row] [23-a: --gate "x y z" --back U --speed 1-3 --tries N --dest town] [11-b: --faction "<enemy>" --calm-tries N]. Recipe v2. ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4.

unblockdefs_c.sh | bash unblockdefs_c.sh <15-bx|20-a|10-b> <lane> [--save S] [--save2 S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--out DIR]. The defs file is itself the runner. Up to 4 EVIDENCE lines + ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4. 10-b: use unblockdefs_e.sh (root-cause fixes).

unblockdefs_e.sh | bash unblockdefs_e.sh 10-b <lane> [--save S] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--victim NAME] [--gift ITEM]. Row 10-b with the sfD root-cause fixes (attack order then hits). ONE RESULT; exit 0/1/2/3/4.
ko13b.sh | ko13b.sh <lane> = trip-run.sh 13-b <lane>.

reload-cycle.sh | reload-cycle.sh <lane> [save-name] [near|far]. Save + load + wait-world verb: records the eventlog max rowid, stobe-auto save/load, waits for phase=world, speed 0.5, re-places the NPC. Prints ONE line RELOAD-CYCLE <lane> <save> PASS|FAIL <detail> (exit 0/2).

hunt26a-scene.sh | hunt26a-scene.sh <outdir>. Builds the passing E-ground Hunt scene on lane 5090-i5 (goats pinned, Cind faction re-serialled, aff 60) and runs the 26-a offer+accept; prints SCENE-OK|SCENE-BAD then OFFER/ACCEPT timing and record/diag lines; evidence in <outdir>. Env: NPC_ID NPC_FULL SAY1 SAY2 REFACTION (early|late|0) REFAC_FACTION. Needs lib-i5.sh sourced paths, lane i5 up at speed 0.5. Other lanes use the sfI scene via reload-run-sfi.sh.

lib-i5.sh | source C:/KenshiTestRuns/imm26-5090-i5/lib-i5.sh (lane 5090-i5 private helper, NOT in git). Functions: i3 (bash body from stdin in WSL with RIG=5090 KAH_INSTANCE=5), i3w (same + private backend env.sh), i3_say <target> <text> [wait_s] (stobe_say + wait for NPC reply, prints reply lines), i3_sql "<select>" (read-only SQL on stobe_imm26_5090_i5), i3_ready (one-screen readiness), i3_mark, i3_since, i3_haff, i3_receipt, i3_selftest. Use MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 only for wsl.exe lines.

lane-setup.sh | lane-setup.sh <5090|4080> <instance 3..9> <save|-> [--with NAME] [--teleport x y z] [--away x y z] [--player NAME] [--clear-faction NAME] [--speed V] [--no-load] [--dry-run [--probe]] [--selftest]. One-command reset: load save, speed 0, squad healed, player to The Hub, outlaws cleared, speed 0.5. Prints RESULT lane-setup <rig> i<n> PASS|FAIL <evidence>.

mark-row.py | python mark-row.py <ROW> <STATUS> "<evidence>" [--lane LANE] [--prev append|drop|keep]. Marks the row in testing/NPC_IMMERSION_26_TESTS.md. STATUS = PASS|FAIL|SETUP-FAIL|GATED|UNRUN. A SETUP-FAIL text MUST contain "needs: recipe|server-fix|native|design|fixture" + what exactly, else refused (exit 2). Easier: status-mark.sh (mark + status + quiet commit in one call).

status-mark.sh | status-mark.sh <agent> <ROW> <STATUS> "<evidence>" [--lane LANE] [--next "<next row>"] [--task "<task>"] [--no-commit] [--no-status] [--dry]. mark-row.py + agent-status.ps1 RUNNING + quiet commit/push of the TESTS file only (git commit -q, pathspec) in one call; prints 3 short lines.

next-row.sh | next-row.sh <lane> [--n N] [--ids] [--claim] [--cards]. Next claimable row for the lane as ONE card (<= 600 chars: RUN command, SETUP, EXPECT, RESULT/evidence path, last attempt) + an "also:" line. --claim mkdir's claims\<row> for the first free one (CLAIMED <row>).

row-card.sh | row-card.sh <row> [lane]. Fixed card (<= 600 chars) for one TESTS row: status, claim, exact RUN command (from row-runners.tsv), SETUP, EXPECT, RESULT line shape + evidence path, last attempt.

logwin.sh | logwin.sh <log> <pattern|since:<regex>|at:HH:MM:SS[+SEC]> [maxchars=2500]. Log window with a built-in noise filter and a cap; RESULT/SETUP-FAIL/PREFLIGHT-FAIL lines are never dropped; the footer names the full filtered file and the source log when it cuts. Env LOGWIN_AND LOGWIN_KEEP_NOISE=1 LOGWIN_I=1 LOGWIN_CUT LOGWIN_SCAN_MB.

wait-row.sh | wait-row.sh <out-file|batch-dir> [max_s=110] [--quiet-sleep]. EXPERIMENTAL. Blocks up to max_s (<= 110) and prints exactly ONE line: RUNNING stage=<last progress line, 120 chars> or RESULT ... / DONE. Use it instead of repeated sleep+tail polls.

kenshi-ctl.ps1 | powershell -NoProfile -File tools/automation/kenshi-ctl.ps1 status|launch [-Save x] [-Gfx low]|stop|restart [-Save x]|health|screenshot|lock|release|idle ["<reason>"]. Lane launches need env KAH_INSTANCE=<n> KAH_OWNER=<lane lock owner> (5090: KAH_GFX=low KAH_VIDEO_MODE='1024 x 768' KAH_FPS=60 KENSHI_MONITOR='\\.\DISPLAY2'). Windowed on the lane slot; never focus the game. The lane brief prints the exact line for your lane.

agent-status.ps1 | powershell -NoProfile -File tools/automation/agent-status.ps1 <name> RUNNING|DONE|FAILED|STOPPED-CONTEXT "<task>" "<step>" "<outputs>" "<next>". Task text must stay identical to the predecessor's (agent-guard rule b). Easier per row: status-mark.sh.

hxrun_02bd.sh | hxrun_02bd.sh <02-bx|02-dx> <lane> --save <saveA> --save2 <saveB> [--out DIR] [--no-reload] [--dry] [--allow-retry "<why>"] [--native] [--faction F] [--victim NPC] [--spot "x y z"]. ONE call per row (imm26-rr02): reload saveA -> preflight -> attempt guard -> rd_02bx/rd_02dx (hxdefs_02bd.sh) -> v2 assert_principle -> up to 6 EVIDENCE lines + ONE RESULT line; exit 0/1/2/3/4. 02-bx: T=Cind+principle text (A), S=spawned Slave Traders control (B); 02-dx: T=H-AFF +60 (A), C=H-AFF 0 (B). Details: rowtools/README_02BD.md.
